coordinator_replay.scope: Focused existing test target run by coordinating agent; not the full suite or engine integration. New scenarios below were not run through IX.

assumptions: Physical dimensions and scene units are teaching assumptions external to IX, not measured material or live engine settings.
All six arithmetic cases reuse the same assumed exact acyclic order with ply=28 and levels=36; only the reference count is asserted for the pinned crane fixture.
Coordinate representation changes are dimensional derivations; no new folds or engine artifacts are generated.
Normalizing by powers of two in lib.rs handles numerical tolerances and supplies no physical unit declaration.
face_levels is one stack respecting the stated pairs, not a canonical witness or exported mesh.

comparison_tolerance.purpose: rounding allowance for manual decimal comparisons only

cases.cross_check: both heights double; the assumed order and its level assignments do not change
coordinate heights halve while physical stack heights remain unchanged
coordinate ratios remain reference values while physical lengths double
0.192 cp * 75 mm/cp = 14.4 mm; this is a re-encoding derivation, not an IX normalization claim
only scene representation changes; all scene lengths are 100 times reference values

deliberate_error_cases.repair: t_cp=0.4/150; state 150 mm per coordinate unit
divide each mm length by 1000 for the proposed one-scene-unit-per-metre mapping

limits: Acyclic exact rigid height is conditional on the parallel-panel model and complete stated overlapping order.
With missing order, levels_exact=false and the reported height is a lower bound; face_levels is absent.
At positive t a cycle refuses the parallel-panel interpretation; its absent rigid height is not zero.
No dynamic foldability, measured material behavior, exporter, Blender/Godot/DLSS import, human learner result, fluent translation approval, or publication is established.
